title: A/P: a bill dated on the as-of date counts, one dated after does not
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendor Y has an unpaid bill dated day D (a past day) and another dated D + 1.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Set the date chip to day D.
  4. Open every bucket.
  5. Look for vendor Y's bill dated D.
  6. Look for vendor Y's bill dated D + 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • the bill dated D is listed.

Step 6:

  • the bill dated D + 1 is not listed.

Why this matters: Payables as of month end must include that day's bills only.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApAgingDetailFetcher.php:95; api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApAgingDetailFetcher.php:127. V1 code, quoted: `->andWhere('vt.date <= :asOfDate')`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-029) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Not yet checked against any build.
